title: Munich Arrhythmia Research Register
summary: Ablation is one possible treatment of arrhythmias with the aim to delete the cause of the arrhythmia directly in the heart. This treatment is very common,  over time several technical methods have been developed. These methods are enhanced and new methods are investigated. As many experiences arise only during clinical daily life and not within clinical studies, it is important to gather as many information as possible from the clinical daily live to retrieve important knowledge concerning techniques, its application and the most appreciate procedural method.

interventions.name:
all patients hospitalized for an ablation at the TUM Klinikum Deutsches Herzzentrum. This includes: 
1. Patients > 18 Jahren
2. Patients < 18 Jahren

criteria:
